digest: finding-002 is real: src/workflow-stop.ts:57 accepts message-prefix matches, which SPEC S6 forbids. Severity lowered to medium because no in-repo caller or test depends on it.

evidence.relevance: isWorkflowStopRequestedError also accepts errors whose message starts with the stop prefix, contrary to S6's name-only rule

evidence.quote: 인정한다. 메시지 내용으로 판별해서는 안 된다.
evidence.relevance: S6 requires name-only recognition and forbids message-content discrimination

counterEvidence.relevance: Internal producers always set the name, so in-repo stop errors do not rely on the message fallback; this lowers practical impact, not the spec violation

finalClaim: S6 violation: isWorkflowStopRequestedError returns true for any Error whose message starts with 'workflow stop requested', not only for name WorkflowStopRequested. No test covers the message-only rejection, and no in-repo caller was found.
recommendedAction: Remove the message-prefix branch at src/workflow-stop.ts:57 so only the error name is checked, and add a unit test that a plain Error with a matching message returns false.
